Brown Advisory Securities LLC Has $21.19 Million Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Stephan Jacobs | Feb 20th, 2018 
Brown Advisory Securities LLC lowered its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.0% during the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The fund owned 137,575 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,421 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up approximately 4.6% of Brown Advisory Securities LLC’s holdings, making the stock its biggest holding. Brown Advisory Securities LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $21,193,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Janus Henderson Group PLC boosted its position in Apple by 301.3% during the second quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,003,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,880,992,000 after acquiring an additional 15,018,790 shares during the last quarter. Harbour Capital Advisors LLC boosted its position in Apple by 14,030.2% during the second quarter. Harbour Capital Advisors LLC now owns 4,515,315 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $31,352,000 after acquiring an additional 4,483,360 shares during the last quarter. Capital Research Global Investors boosted its position in Apple by 15.0% during the second quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,241,383,000 after acquiring an additional 3,845,363 shares during the last quarter. Arrowstreet Capital Limited Partnership boosted its position in Apple by 200.3% during the second quarter. Arrowstreet Capital Limited Partnership now owns 4,765,574 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $686,338,000 after acquiring an additional 3,178,809 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Principal Financial Group Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 25.3% during the second quarter. Principal Financial Group Inc. now owns 10,582,632 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,524,110,000 after acquiring an additional 2,138,928 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 59.70% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $172.93 on Tuesday. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $135.10 and a fifty-two week high of $180.10. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. The company has a market cap of $875,520.00, a PE ratio of 16.92, a PEG ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 1.33. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the previous year, the business posted $3.36 EPS. analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.46 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
The company also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th were paid a dividend of $0.63 per share. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.46%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. Apple’s payout ratio is 24.66%. 
AAPL has been the topic of a number of research analyst reports. Sanford C. Bernstein upgraded shares of Apple to an “outperform” rating and set a $175.00 price target on the stock in a report on Monday, October 23rd. Royal Bank of Canada reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 23rd. UBS Group reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 23rd. Drexel Hamilton reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $208.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, October 24th. Finally, initiated coverage on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 25th. They issued a “buy” rating and a $193.00 price target on the stock. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have given a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $201.64.

Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
